user.title: Select Connection Mode
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant connects to your Felicity Solar battery/system:

local.title: Direct Local Network Connection
local.description: Connect directly to the battery over your local Wi-Fi or LAN network without cloud or internet dependency.

data.invert_current: Invert current sign (HA standard: negative = charging, positive = discharging)

cloud.title: Connect to Felicity Solar Cloud
cloud.description: Enter your Felicity Solar (Fsolar app) account credentials. Login can be Email, Phone number (as registered), or Username.

plant.title: Select Solar Plant
plant.description: Choose the solar power plant / installation to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Felicity ESS
reauth_confirm.description: Your Felicity Solar session has expired. Please enter your credentials again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to battery or cloud service.
error.timeout: Connection to battery timed out. Verify IP and that port 53970 is reachable.
error.protocol_error: Received invalid response from battery local TCP port.
error.user_not_found: Account not found. If you registered in Fsolar with a mobile phone, enter that number (with or without country code).
error.invalid_password: Wrong account password. Please verify your Fsolar password.
error.rsa_error: Encryption error occurred while preparing credentials. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.
error.no_plants: No solar plants found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Felicity ESS battery or plant is already configured.
